observed.effect: Discover source ownership first, then patch only independently verified source packages; never bulk-edit mirrors by filename match.
observed.layer_result: The recurring authoring request qualifies, but implementation permission is blocked until each repository's source/runtime relationship is evidenced.
observed.response: 先为三个仓库分别建立轻量 Evidence Matrix：候选同名文件、治理/catalog/生成标记证据、受保护行为和 implementation_permission。只有确认为 source 且 permission=ready 的 package 才升级；generated、vendored、symlink 或缓存副本不直接修改。若存在多个独立 source，分别适配各仓库契约并独立验证；仍无法判定的仓库只提交建议，不猜测写入。
observed.source_owner_assumption: No source owner is assumed from the shared skill name; ownership must be established per repository.
